items.title: Why Developer Teams Are Moving From Contentful to Cosmic in 2026
items.summary: Contentful made sense in 2018. In 2026, developer teams are choosing Cosmic for transparent pricing, a sub-100ms REST API, TypeScript SDK, MCP Server, and AI agents that actually work inside Slack. Here is a direct, honest comparison.
